craft_notes: Sthāyin: born-of-waste (the inversion closes the block: dissolving BIRTHS). Sanskrit: nirvṛkṣagiribhittyādideśe...vṛttikṣiṇaḥ prajāyate → L4 keeps place-list + birth. Rows: row 3 (dissolved→born). Close: born (prajāyate — the block ends on genesis, not nullity: the ash makes). Rejected: 'purification' — killed: wasting kept; 'shatters' — killed: dissolves kept.

lines: Treeless mountain, wall, such place: gaze cast well;
mind dissolved in state — the wasting of turning is born.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirvṛkṣagiribhittyādideśe dṛṣṭiṃ vinikṣipet | vilīne mānase bhāve vṛttikṣiṇaḥ prajāyate

reads_against.argmap: What is born when mind dissolves? → Where mind dissolves, the wasting of turning is born out.
c1_essence: Mountain-wall gaze: mind dissolved, turning's wasting born.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
